'''Sanchango''' was a game of chance.<ref name="HNNA">{{JournalCite|12|Heroes Need Not Apply}}</ref> It was played by throwing a metal ball into a machine that stood upright in an effort to dislodge other balls. Each ball won was worth a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]].<ref name="TAS">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=The Argovia Strike}}</ref> It could be played at [[The Grinder Dance Hall]] in [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]] alongside [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[hyper-dejarik]].<ref name="HNNA" /> It was also popular at [[Tanza's]] casino in [[Argovas City]].<ref name="TAS" />
